author: انا الا
title: Amazing game with impressive progress and updates
content: This game is genuinely captivating and the continuous updates show how much care goes into its development. Having joined just two months ago, I was instantly drawn to the charming storyline and smooth gameplay, but my inability to speak English keeps me from fully enjoying the narrative context. I completely understand that integrating a new language into an established title requires immense effort and essentially building localization from the ground up, but adding Arabic support would open the doors for a massive community to finally connect with the plot. Granting a few more opportunities for extra lives alongside Arabic language options would solve the only real friction points in this experience and make an already brilliant game truly complete. Your dedication to creating such a vibrant world is clearly visible in every detail, and the passion behind this game is what makes players like me fall in love with it so quickly. It breaks my heart to miss out on the rich dialogues and character moments simply because of a language barrier, especially when the narrative is clearly crafted with so much heart. By bringing Arabic language support to the game, you would not just be translating words, you would be giving millions of devoted players the gift of truly feeling at home inside your story. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your endless hard work, for listening to your community, and for continuing to make this game such a joyful part of our daily lives.♥️

author: начинаетебесить!
content:
The game was actually fun and interesting at first. Unfortunately, the last couple of months have completely changed that.

It now feels like the levels are designed specifically to make you use boosters or BUY extra moves. And then comes the best part: apparently, the developers decided on their own to turn some players into “testers” without asking for their permission.

Congratulations — I’m one of the lucky ones! 🎉

The levels are ridiculously difficult, and many of them seem practically impossible to pass without another 30 extra moves. So forget about saving your coins — you simply won’t collect enough of them. The obvious solution? Keep spending real money. What a brilliant “feature.”

And then they added a new “Legendary” card collection. Sounds exciting, right? Not really. In an entire month, I personally received only THREE cards from this collection. Three. So if you were hoping to complete the collection and get the reward, good luck with that!

I’ve contacted customer support multiple times. The conversations are full of polite explanations and absolutely no solution. They keep telling me that they “cannot” remove me from the tester group. At this point, it really feels more like they simply don’t want to.

The result? I don’t even feel like playing anymore.

So, if you enjoy being “rewarded” with impossible levels, spending money on extra moves, and collecting three Legendary cards a month — this might be the perfect game for you. 😂

content: I’ve played Homescapes for 7-8 years now and get back into playing it every once in a while. Coming back this time there was both new things I liked and new things I didn’t like. I really like the card collecting and the weights mini challenge. I don’t know how I feel about the newer animations. It seems more brightly colored and in your face, rather than more of a calming scene. The old animations were more satisfying to watch IMO. For example, I liked to watch the stone cat break when it was destroyed, now it just disappears. Let me get to the point, the main thing I don’t like is how unchallenging the game became. I’ve probably played through 100-200 levels over the past couple days and I have beaten them all on the first or second try. The constant power ups makes it less of a challenge; the cat’s gift is always there, and the super ball is easy to obtain. There is also so many power ups that just spawn in the game due to levels not using all the game piece colors. I don’t really have to do much and everything just blows up. I liked how the levels used to be a challenge and more central to the game. While I do like some of the extra stuff, it takes away from the original levels and restoring of the mansions. The game is now about collecting stuff for so many different things and not about beating levels to design the mansions like it used to be.

Also, the airplane power ups that will take out a colored block to drop down a donut down one space instead of taking out a stone statue which can only be taken out by a power up. I realize the game is designed to get you to a point to spend money but it is going to drive some players away because it simply is an unfair part of the game. Shrinkflation is when you pay the same amount for an item but get less product. ( a 5 oz product being sold for 5 dollars where a few years earlier you could get 10 oz of the same product for 5 dollars). In the case of this game, it’s doing things they used to earn you  loads of boosters, coins, or energy that give you so little now. I felt like I was going crazy seeing the prizes for things I remember getting in previous events go down 100 coins, or losing 15 minutes of infinite lives, or getting less coins from the treasure chests in events, or the disappearance of prizes from events in general. There’s no reason to get rid of these prizes for any reason other than to get people to purchase prizes with real money, which is think I’d despicable for an app that advertises to be free of ads and predatory advertising. I’m sick of it.
